GOV-20714
create or alter function [dbo].[XMLRemoveInValidChar] ( @FieldValue nvarchar(4000) ) returns nvarchar(4000) WITH SCHEMABINDING , RETURNS NULL ON NULL INPUT as begin declare @illegalChars nvarchar(4000) = char(0) + char(1) + char(2) + char(3) + char(4) + char(5) + char(6) + char(7) + char(8) + char(11) + char(12) + char(14) + char(15) + char(16) + char(17) + char(18) + char(19) + char(20) + char(21) + char(22) + char(23) + char(24) + char(25) + char(26) + char(27) + char(28) + char(29) + char(30) + char(31);
declare @XMLData nvarchar(4000)
if @FieldValue is not null begin set @XMLData = replace(translate(@FieldValue, @illegalChars, replicate(char(1), len(@illegalChars))),char(1),''); end
return @XMLData end
